summary: Solver-visible core has a real coupled Terraform-plan/IRSA/PDB/placement/checkpoint path, but measured scale is dominated by unreachable modules and a 12,500-record estate corpus never consumed by runtime logic; drain/interruption/availability steps are constant-output shells. Padding and toy risk are HIGH, so production-logic PASS is blocked.

evidence.observation: Primary operator entrypoint runs terraform init/validate/plan/show then upgrade_lab.run_rollout(plan); graded workflow is offline plan+lab, not live AWS.

execute_rollout loads only cluster_snapshot, compatibility_matrix, trust_observations, pdbs, regulated_policy, and defaults; never opens telemetry_history.json or interruption_events.json. Availability for core_services is unconditionally set True; drain is called with pdb_respected=True hardcoded.
Build-time generator writes 12,000 telemetry metrics and 500 interruption events explicitly to reach 12,500+ primary records.
Image build runs /app/bin/generate-fixtures, materializing the unused estate JSON into /app/data.
simulate_node_drain returns fixed evicted_count/blocked_count constants when pdb_respected is true; no PDB/pod inventory branching.
simulate_node_interruption only checks regulated capacity_types == {on-demand} and placement_ok; does not read interruption_events.json.
MockAWSLab is defined but never imported by __init__, app, cli, coordinator, or bin entrypoints.
Large dataclass portfolio (~250 LOC) is never imported by any other upgrade_lab module; runtime uses plain dicts.
Exception hierarchy is never raised or imported by reachable runtime modules.
Substantive reachable logic: parses resource_changes into addons/roles/node_groups/regulated/protected_actions with IAM subject and policy extraction.
Substantive reachable multi-check policy engine for addon versions, IRSA subjects, system taints, regulated capacity, and UpgradeProtected deletes.
Broken starter Terraform encodes coupled domain defects (wrong IRSA subjects, OVERWRITE conflicts, missing CriticalAddonsOnly taint, spot regulated capacity).
allowed_policy_prefixes are present but unused by plan_validator (only forbidden_policy_actions consulted).
Task declares advanced multi-language systems package with artifacts under terraform/k8s/var/upgrade/output; no LOC measurement substitutes for reachable domain logic.
Q6 requires reachability, non-clone modules, data volume consumed by branches, removal-test materiality, and (for large_system_strict) >=3000 substantive reachable LOC with no HIGH toy/padding risk.
Strict Q6 PASS requires >=3000 substantive reachable production/domain runtime/config LOC, no HIGH toy/padding risk, and credible production characteristics; raw LOC cannot produce PASS.

findings.criterion: Data/state volume must drive domain branches; opaque filler and HIGH padding risk block PASS
findings.why_it_matters: 12,000 telemetry + 500 interruption records are generated at image build and never loaded by execute_rollout or interruption simulation; config.telemetry_file/interruption_file are unused. This is benchmark inflation of primary-record scale without runtime consumption.
findings.minimal_remediation: Either wire telemetry/interruption corpora into graded branches with material failure modes, or remove generate-fixtures and the unused JSON inventories and replace with state that the coordinator actually evaluates.
findings.regression_risk: Removing unused datasets should not change READY/FAILED outcomes today; wiring them in will require new invariants and verifier alignment.

findings.criterion: Major modules must be reachable from real entrypoints; dead/unreachable code must not inflate the production core
findings.why_it_matters: aws_lab.MockAWSLab, types.py dataclasses, and errors.py hierarchy are never imported on the operator path. Removing them does not change rollout behavior, so they fail the removal/reachability test and pad module/LOC surface.
findings.minimal_remediation: Delete unreachable modules or integrate them into the graded entrypoint path with distinct branching that partial fixes must satisfy.
findings.regression_risk: Low if deleted unused; integration would expand coupling and need coordinated terraform/k8s/report contracts.

findings.criterion: Business/runtime modules need material branching/state/error behavior, not constant-output shells
findings.why_it_matters: After PDBs pass, coordinator hardcodes availability True and pdb_respected True; drain returns fixed counts; interruption ignores event history and reduces to a capacity-type set check. These named reliability stages are toy wrappers around earlier boolean outcomes.
findings.minimal_remediation: Implement drain/interruption/availability evaluation from submitted PDBs, workloads, node inventories, and interruption events with independent failure reasons and partial-fix traps.
findings.regression_risk: Medium: richer simulation will interact with PDB/placement checks and digest fields.

findings.criterion: Strict Q6 PASS requires >=3000 substantive reachable production/domain runtime/config LOC and credible non-padded scale
findings.why_it_matters: Reachable substantive surface is dominated by plan_normalizer, plan_validator, coordinator, IRSA/k8s/placement, and the broken Terraform/k8s starters (~low-thousands at best once dead modules and unused generators are excluded). Combined with HIGH padding from Q6-1/Q6-2, the core does not meet the strict reachable-LOC floor or production-credibility bar.
findings.minimal_remediation: Expand genuinely reachable domain logic (or select a richer work package) until substantive reachable runtime/config logic exceeds the strict floor without dead modules or unread corpora.
findings.regression_risk: High if scale is added as more unused files; keep growth on the execute_rollout call graph.

do_not_change: verifier/tests (outside Q6 production scope unless contracts must track new runtime branches)
instruction.md wording solely to narrate padding removal
next_gate: Q6_REVISE -> producer remediation of solver-visible production core -> QUALITY_INTERLOCK

role_output.SUBSTANTIVE_LOC_ASSESSMENT: Reachable graded path centers on plan_normalizer (~185), plan_validator (~128), rollout_coordinator (~204), irsa/k8s/placement/pdb/checkpoint/digests/report/config/cli (~450), plus broken Terraform main/workspace and k8s starters (~400). Dead aws_lab/types/errors (~385) and fixture_generator (~89) plus unread 12.5k-record JSON do not count. Net substantive reachable runtime/config LOC is well below the strict 3000 floor and is diluted by HIGH padding.
MAJOR_MODULES: bin/addon-trust-rollout + upgrade_lab.app/cli: terraform plan show then execute_rollout
irsa_verifier + k8s_parser + pdb_analyzer: manifest binding and PDB coverage
matrix_evaluator + checkpoint_manager + rollout_coordinator: ordered addon readiness with checkpoints
placement_engine + interruption_handler + drain_simulator: placement/drain/interruption (latter two thin)
PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Fix Terraform IRSA/versions without correcting k8s SA annotations/PDB names/regulated selectors still fails later stages
Satisfy IRSA subjects but share role ARNs across trusts fails cross_service_denied
Fix regulated Terraform capacity without matching workload nodeSelectors fails placement/interruption
Checkpointed mid-rollout resume depends on prerequisite order and fail_addon readiness gates
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing ~25% focused on telemetry JSON, fixture_generator, aws_lab, types, errors, and drain/interruption shells leaves READY/FAILED outcomes of the plan+IRSA+PDB+placement path essentially unchanged. Removing ~25% of plan_normalizer/plan_validator/coordinator/IRSA/k8s wiring collapses graded behavior. Therefore a large fraction of solver-visible bulk is non-behavioral padding.
REQUIRED_CHANGES: Eliminate or truly consume estate telemetry/interruption corpora in graded logic
Remove or integrate unreachable aws_lab/types/errors modules
Replace constant drain/interruption/availability shells with state-consuming domain logic
Grow substantive reachable runtime/config logic above the strict floor without unread filler
